manifest.name: Marsel Blur
manifest.author: Marsel
manifest.description: Anisotropic Gaussian, box or directional blur, with alpha, quality and edge controls.

manifest.name: Marsel Color Correction
manifest.author: Marsel
manifest.description: Exposure, brightness, contrast, gamma, shadows, highlights, saturation and colour balance.

manifest.name: Marsel Deep Glow
manifest.author: Marsel
manifest.description: Multi-scale coloured glow with a long halo; original implementation, not the commercial Deep Glow plugin.

manifest.name: Marsel Drop Shadow
manifest.author: Marsel
manifest.description: Alpha-based object shadow with a two-colour gradient, blur and editable bounds.

manifest.name: Marsel Edge Glow
manifest.author: Marsel
manifest.description: Two editable colours for the edge and its brightest glow.

manifest.name: Marsel Film Grain
manifest.author: Marsel
manifest.description: Deterministic animated grain with size, colour and speed controls.

manifest.name: Marsel JPEG Damage
manifest.author: Marsel
manifest.description: JPEG-style 8x8 DCT quantization and chroma subsampling. Bitrate is an estimated visual budget, not file encoding.

manifest.name: Marsel Pixelate
manifest.author: Marsel
manifest.description: Block-average or nearest pixelation with grid size, offsets and colour levels.

manifest.name: Marsel RGB Split
manifest.author: Marsel
manifest.description: Independent channel offsets, colours and gains; common position, rotation and radial splitting.

manifest.name: Marsel Selective Light
manifest.author: Marsel
manifest.description: Positionable elliptical light with feather, a colour gradient and blend modes.

manifest.name: Marsel Vignette
manifest.author: Marsel
manifest.description: Resizable coloured vignette with centre, feather, shape and inversion.

manifest.name: Marsel Camera Shake
manifest.author: Marsel
manifest.description: Automatic XYZ image-plane shake, rotation, smooth motion and sampled shutter blur.

manifest.name: Marsel Flash
manifest.author: Marsel
manifest.description: Automatic coloured flicker with selectable rhythm, duty cycle and eight programmable beat levels.

manifest.name: Marsel Fragment Glitch
manifest.author: Marsel
manifest.description: Animated fragments of the source image with subtle displacement; no external images required.

manifest.name: Marsel Shake
manifest.author: Marsel
manifest.description: Independent Amount/Frequency shake with random and wave components; original implementation.
